item.title: llms.txt: Making AI Understand Your Website
item.description: 1. What llms.txt Is llms.txt is a convention: put a Markdown file at the root of your site, and use plain language to tell large language models and AI agents what the site is, which content is worth reading, and what each piece covers. It was proposed by Jeremy Howard (Answer.
